gates.detail: Cleared consumer-smoke/{node_modules,package-lock.json,dist}, then npm run install:engine (installed the packed tarball, 5 packages), npm run build (tsc), npm run smoke (node dist/smoke.js) — all exit 0. consumer-smoke/package-lock.json restored from git afterwards; working tree clean.

gates.detail: [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile over every *.ps1 outside node_modules — no parse errors

gates.name: Run Pester tests
gates.detail: Invoke-Pester -Path tools — Tests Passed: 324, Failed: 0, Skipped: 35, NotRun: 0, in 114.66s

gates.name: Validate Markdown links, terminology, and generated files
gates.detail: pwsh -File build/Test-Documentation.ps1 — drift check passed across 18 generated engine pages, compatibility pointers and the guide; documentation checks passed across 200 Markdown files

gates.name: Build documentation
gates.reason: docs.ps1 is not present in this worktree. It is installed by Invoke-SetupDocs and deliberately not committed (CLAUDE.md, Docs Site), so there is nothing to invoke. The production Docusaurus build also pulls ghcr.io/the-running-dev/docs-template, which needs registry credentials this session does not hold. The Verify Documentation Build check on the PR is where this answer comes from.

gates.name: Build and verify landing page
gates.detail: npm --prefix src/engine run build; npm --prefix site run check — vite built both entry points, both built HTML entry points carry their required static metadata, 3 bundles free of Node-only runtime references, and the package-backed merge verification passed for '/', '/roadmap/' and the protected docs/ subtree

gates.name: Merge landing page into documentation build
gates.reason: Requires a completed documentation build in artifacts/docs, and the Build documentation gate above did not run. Note that the landing gate's own package-backed merge fixture did pass, but that is a different assertion and is not a substitute for this one.

gates.name: Test the host
gates.detail: dotnet test src/host/SubZeroDev.GameEngine.Host.Tests/SubZeroDev.GameEngine.Host.Tests.csproj -c Release — Passed! Failed: 0, Passed: 12, Skipped: 0, Total: 12. NUGET_GITHUB_TOKEN is unset here; restore nevertheless succeeded from cached packages, so this gate was run rather than assumed.

gates.name: Positive route and probe smoke
gates.reason: The step depends on an earlier unflagged step building subzerodev-gameengine-host:smoke, which needs secrets.REGISTRY_TOKEN twice over — to pull the ghcr.io/the-running-dev/docs-template base image and to restore SubZeroDev.Platform.Hosting from the private GitHub Packages feed. Neither credential is available in this session, and handling one is not something this session does. Docker itself is running; the credentials are the blocker.

gates.name: Negative fixture -- corrupted artifact must fail to start
gates.reason: Builds from the same subzerodev-gameengine-host:smoke image as the positive smoke above, so it is blocked by the same missing secrets.REGISTRY_TOKEN.
